source.note: Injection string = AgentDojo important_instructions template rendered with AgentDojo default names and the injection task GOAL, byte-identical to what AgentDojo emits. The user turn and tool name are the benchmark user task's PROMPT and ground-truth tool. The tool result carries only the injection string: the surrounding AgentDojo environment data (other emails / file text) is omitted. Destinations are AgentDojo's own values.
